name: Daru
reason: 3 counted sources, 5931 page views

name: Kiunga
reason: 3 counted sources, 3206 page views

name: Tabubil
reason: Fails rule 1 and 2: no visitor source (Wikivoyage, PNG tourism) names it as a stop; re-looked, Wikivoyage mentions it only as the mine corridor with controlled access. A company mine town with no visitor draw.

name: Ok Tedi Mine
reason: Rule 2: working industrial site, controlled access, Wikivoyage says not to photograph it; nothing a visitor can do.

name: Lake Murray
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage lists it as an 'other destination' (largest lake in PNG; birdwatching, fishing, village visits) and it is a distinct natural place; second-tier stop a real source names. Lodge (Lake Murray Lodge) goes in the bio as the way in, plus charter aircraft.

name: Lake Murray Lodge
reason: An accommodation operator, not a place (COVERAGE: lodge is not a spot); the place is Lake Murray.

name: Bensbach Wildlife Lodge
reason: Lodge/operator, not a spot; the place it serves is Tonda Wildlife Management Area (kept) and the Bensbach River.

name: Suki Eco-Lodge
reason: Lodge listed for fishing; operator not a place, no coordinates, no distinct place identified beyond a fishing village.

name: Angling Adventures
reason: Tour operator, not a place; its destination is the Bensbach River, covered by Tonda WMA.

name: Kiunga Nature Tours
reason: Operator, not a place; the place is Kiunga (already an audit entry).

name: Ecotourism Melanesia
reason: Operator/tour company, not a place.

name: Fly River
reason: Rule 1 met (two counted sources; PNG tourism names it as a great river, Wikivoyage describes river trips from Daru and Kiunga). But a 1,060 km river is a linear feature with no single visitor point: case for: obvious headline feature of the province; case against: Wikivoyage warns passenger boats are not available, no distinct place to stand, pin would be arbitrary (needs a visitor access point, e.g. Kiunga river port).

name: Fly River Delta
reason: Rule 3: near-duplicate of Fly River and Kiwai Island; no coordinates; Wikivoyage's delta entry names Kiwai Island as its main visit.

name: Kiwai Island
reason: One counted source (Wikivoyage: charter boat trip from Daru to the delta's largest island, 59 km long, villages). For: a real named place, a distinct visit, Wikipedia article with coordinates. Against: single source, needs a charter, a long visit to villages with permission; unclear what a visitor does for half an hour.

name: Parama Island
reason: Rule 1: no visitor source; village island with no stated visitor activity.

name: Tonda Wildlife Management Area
reason: Rules 1-4: two counted sources (PNG tourism 'must see', Wikivoyage other destination); largest protected area and Ramsar wetland with wildlife drives and birdwatching; reached through Bensbach Wildlife Lodge by charter flight, mention in bio.

name: Wawoi Falls
reason: Rule 2: PNG tourism's line is 'decide if it is our largest waterfall', no access, location or visit information; no coordinates and no second source; cannot confirm a visitor can reach it.

name: Hindenburg Wall
reason: One counted source (PNG tourism 'must see': limestone cliff escarpment, Star Mountains). For: a genuine natural landmark the tourism board promotes. Against: access only with customary landowners, no coordinates, no visitor facilities, no second source.

name: Mount Fubilan
reason: Rule 2: the peak no longer exists, replaced by the Ok Tedi pit; no public access.

name: Balimo
reason: Rule 4: only draw is occasional canoe races (events); no permanent visitor site and Wikivoyage names no stop.

name: Strickland River
reason: Rule 3: river as a feature, no visitor point; tourism board mentions it only in the introduction, not as a stop.
